verified_facts: determined boundary is distinct from general boundary
determined boundary records exact line after line is identified
determined boundary plan should normally be professionally prepared
preferred plan scale is no smaller than 1:200
measurement-based plan measurements must be accurate to plus/minus 10 mm
measurements must be horizontal rather than along slope
measurements must use at least two defined permanent feature points
coordinate-based plans accept National Grid coordinates only
National Grid coordinate absolute accuracy must be plus/minus 300 mm
National Grid coordinate relative accuracy must be plus/minus 10 mm
permanent ground markers can provide survey control where physical features are lacking
general/title-plan mapping alone cannot be treated as exact legal boundary evidence
quality_effect: Prevents indicative/general title-plan geometry from being promoted to exact parcel-boundary measurement without determined-boundary evidence.
